scripts.title: Simulate Tower Placement V1.11
scripts.features:
This script basically allows you to simulate placing certain towers.

!! WORKS ON ALL EXECUTORS !!

**SCRIPT UPDATE! VERSION 1.11!**
- New Tower List (I added this because I literally forgot every tower in the game...)
- FAQ panel inside of script that gives you the link to this page!
- Fixed the goofy ahh looking logs panel

**SCRIPT FEATURES:**
- Allows you to simulate placing every tower in the game!
- Also allows you to simulate certain skins for each tower!
- Tower List
- Spawn logs

**NOTE: IF YOU DO PLACE TOWERS, YOU WILL BE KICKED AND YOUR ACCOUNT WILL BE FLAGGED! NEVER PLACE ANYTHING THAT IS NOT IN YOUR LOADOUT!**

FAQ's: 
Q: Why does the game crash the minute I leave the lobby to join the actual game? 
A: It is because you executed the script inside of the lobby.

Q: Why do I get kicked every time I place the tower? 
A: It is because you don't officially have it in your loadout. (And if you're trying to simulate a tower you have in your loadout), it also may be because you don't have enough money for the tower. 

Q: Why doesn't the tower spawn?
A: It is because you didn't type in the name of the Tower or Skin correctly. The correct way, for example is "Gladiator", not "gladiator." It also may be because you didn't type in the name correctly. It may also be because you didn't hit "Enter" in the textbox you were typing in.

**If you think this script is at least decent, make sure to give a like. Enjoy!**
